name: Rogue Lineage
description: Shows mana as a percentage over the mana bar with marked spell ranges, and flashes a warning when Gate is cast outside its range. Shades hotbar skills while they cool down, with a countdown, and tells the Autoclicker widget when the backpack is open so it can pause. Windows only. Reads the screen, hotbar keys, and mouse clicks on this device. Nothing is sent anywhere.
